  {"step":5,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"load_jpeg_image","line":3760,"var":"r->vs","code":"r->vs = z->img_v_max / z->img_comp[k].v;","note":"The vertical expansion ratio is computed the same way."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src-vul/stb/stb_image.h","function":"load_jpeg_image","line":3770,"var":"r->resample","code":"else                               r->resample = stbi__resample_row_generic;","note":"Unsupported combinations fall through to the generic resampler instead of being rejected."},
